lines.text: How can sending slower make a message reach farther?
Far away, the signal sinks into the noise.
Bluetooth's long range mode spends eight symbols on every bit.
That extra code lets the receiver fix errors in a weak signal.
The cost: eight times slower. The gain: about four times the range.
That is why long range modes suit short messages, not videos.
Download Meshline for private nearby messages, even offline.
